description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings within a web application's UI, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case formats. It provides publicly exported functions used for consistent string normalization across components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling delimiters like spaces, underscores, and hyphens, with examples like 'John Doe' -> 'johnDoe'.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of each word and the letter after apostrophes, while normalizing delimiters and spacing.
